# Prompt Engineering Challenge Generator

A Python CLI that generates prompt engineering challenges, injection-resistant
test cases, and promptfoo evaluation assets from a theme.

## Canonical pages

- Documentation site: https://mikaeltorni.github.io/prompt_challenge_generator/
- Repository: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator
- README: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator/blob/master/README.md
- Entry point: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator/blob/master/main.py
- Arguments: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator/blob/master/src/Args.py
- Promptfoo: https://www.promptfoo.dev/
- Generation diagram: https://mikaeltorni.github.io/prompt_challenge_generator/generation-flow.svg

## Quickstart

```bash
uv sync --locked
uv run main.py --help
```

Set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and pass a non-empty `--theme` to generate a challenge.

## Scope

The CLI writes challenge and promptfoo evaluation assets; it is not a hosted
model or promptfoo service.
